findings.text: resolve_landing_tests' docstring states four sources are tried in order, naming 'the test files its diff changed' as the second, but the implementation at :672-680 tries only three: fenced test files, done-when-named files, then importer files. A test file present in `changed` but neither fenced nor named in the done-when is not selected directly by this function; delivery_scope.py:84-92 handles diff-changed test files in a separate candidates branch before calling it. A reader trusting the docstring believes this function covers a source it does not, and a direct caller passing test_files=() with a changed test file gets the refusal path. Non-blocking: every production caller either passes fenced/diff-derived tests or resolves candidates first, so the current refusal text is not reached on the landing path.

_GATE_PROFILE_TIME_RE requires a colon form or an s/m/h suffix, so a quoted plain-seconds duration such as time: "900" is refused at load, while parse_gate_duration at landing_measure.py:1024-1027 accepts an unsuffixed count. An integer time: 900 passes validation (the isinstance branch at :1802-1804), but the string spelling of the same duration is refused, so the validator and the reader disagree on an accepted form. Safe direction (refuses rather than misreads), but the two owners should accept the same set. Non-blocking.
